question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Enough** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Enough **means sufficient or adequate in amount or degree. (मात्रा या डिग्री में पर्याप्त या पर्याप्त) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits grammatically and semantically in the sentence. • **Example**: *I have enough money to buy a new car.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Few **means a small number of something. (किसी चीज़ की छोटी संख्या) • **Many **refer to a large number of something. (किसी चीज़ की बड़ी संख्या) • **Little **means a small amount of something. (किसी चीज़ की थोड़ी मात्रा) 49:T7d5, The correct answer is: **Across**.
